description: Run 18 re-proved the voting set is exactly TCPI and Variance at Completion and that no disabled module votes. No P0A item.
A single Red is absorbed rather than escalated, so an adverse signal can leave the project rollup unmoved. Run-17 finding, re-executed unchanged in Run 18.
Adding benign evidence dilutes an adverse rollup, so evidence volume can move status without any change in project condition. Run-17 finding, re-executed unchanged.
Composite re-weights on availability, so a project with fewer supplied inputs is scored on a different basis than one with more. Run-17 finding, re-executed unchanged.

Category-6 ensembles consume assembled signal statuses directly, with no qualification step between raw evidence and synthesis. The deviation is declared in signal_package.py rather than prevented in code. Run-17 finding, re-executed unchanged in Run 18.

No module result carries a lineage identifier, so an ensemble cannot distinguish one piece of evidence seen twice from two independent pieces. A second transform of the same adverse cost index raises the adverse count. Run-17 finding, re-executed unchanged.
Four modules carry a canonical method name their implementation does not implement. Run-17 finding, unchanged. Owner decision required on rename, proxy qualifier or rebuild.
One module lacks the canonical structure its declared method requires. Run-17 finding, unchanged.

Beta-PERT distribution parameters unsourced; CUSUM k and h and the Isolation Forest 0.576 threshold calibrated on synthetic data only; the four Category-6 ensemble bands are unversioned owner policy. Retuning requires a governed non-synthetic study.
Worst-N-of-M's collapsing form makes it redundant with the primary ensemble. Proxy qualifiers to be disclosed consistently. Run-17 finding, unchanged.

Run 18 could not assess the 79 outstanding modules because the controlling theoretical contract is not in the repository. Run 17 recorded it as SUPPLIED_IN_PROMPT; the 79 method cards are empty stubs; the only in-repository descriptions are regenerated exports of the production code. Commit the specification, or supply an independently defensible per-module contract, before any further scientific assessment. THIS IS THE SINGLE HIGHEST-VALUE ITEM IN THE QUEUE.
The eight concept-only methods remain operationally disabled and no incremental research value has been demonstrated for any of them. No activation is proposed.

Registered, audit history retained, operationally disabled under EVIDENCE AND CONTEXT REQUIREMENT UNDER OWNER REVIEW, non-voting, excluded from the 100 result rows. Not mathematically disproved. Awaiting an owner evidence decision.
